metaDescription: Slack is a team messaging app with channels, huddles, workflows, AI and thousands of app integrations. See its features, Free, Pro, Business+ and Enterprise+ pricing, strengths and limitations.
overview: Slack is a messaging app for teams, organised into channels, with direct messages, threads, audio and video huddles, and integrations with thousands of apps. Every message, file and conversation on paid plans is saved and fully searchable.

AI features are built into paid plans, including summaries, huddle notes, AI search and workflow generation, with more on Business+ and Enterprise+. The free plan keeps 90 days of message history and up to 10 app integrations; paid plans are billed only for active users.

features.title: Channels and DMs
features.text: Organise conversations by topic, team or project, with threads and direct messages.

features.title: Huddles
features.text: Quick audio and video calls, with group huddles on paid plans.

features.title: App integrations
features.text: Connect thousands of apps, with up to 10 on the free plan.

features.title: Workflows
features.text: Automate routine tasks with workflows, including AI workflow generation.

features.title: Slack AI
features.text: Summaries, huddle notes, AI search and recaps on paid plans.

features.title: Slack Connect
features.text: Collaborate with outside organizations and guests in shared channels.

strengths: AI features included on paid plans.
Fair billing: you only pay for active members.
limitations: The free plan keeps only 90 days of message history.
Free workspaces are limited to 10 app integrations.
SAML SSO needs Business+ or higher.
Prices rose in 2025; Business+ is now $15 per user a month, billed yearly.

pricing.summary: Free plan available. Paid plans are priced per active user. Prices below are US prices billed yearly; monthly billing costs more, and Slack sometimes runs introductory discounts.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 90 days of message history · up to 10 apps · 1:1 huddles

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Billed yearly, or $8.75 monthly · unlimited history · AI summaries

plans.name: Business+
plans.note: Billed yearly, or $18 monthly · SAML SSO · advanced AI features

plans.name: Enterprise+
plans.note: AI enterprise search · advanced security and compliance
